explanation.en: “an annual rent of £45, which is due on 1 March” → 1 March. £45 is the amount, but the question asks for a date.
explanation.kk: «an annual rent of £45, which is due on 1 March» → 1 March. £45 — сома, ал сұрақ күнді сұрайды.
explanation.ru: «an annual rent of £45, which is due on 1 March» → 1 March. £45 — сумма, а спрашивают дату.

explanation.en: “At least three quarters of each plot” → three quarters. Leave out “at least”, or it goes over two words.
explanation.kk: «At least three quarters of each plot» → three quarters. «At least» жазбаймыз: екі сөзден асып кетеді.
explanation.ru: «At least three quarters of each plot» → three quarters. «At least» не пишем: получится больше двух слов.

RT-GT-SA-02-Q2.quote: At least three quarters of each plot should be used for growing

explanation.en: “Bonfires are only permitted between October and February” → October. November in paragraph 4 is when the water is turned off.
explanation.kk: «Bonfires are only permitted between October and February» → October. 4-абзацтағы November — су өшірілетін ай.
explanation.ru: «Bonfires are only permitted between October and February» → October. November в абзаце 4 — когда отключают воду.

explanation.en: Hosepipes are banned, and the rules say “please use watering cans”. The answer is watering cans, plural as in the text.
explanation.kk: Шлангқа тыйым салынған, ережеде: «please use watering cans». Жауап watering cans — мәтіндегідей көпше түрде.
explanation.ru: Шланги запрещены, и правила говорят: «please use watering cans». Ответ watering cans — во множественном числе, как в тексте.

explanation.en: “they must not be taller than two metres” → two metres. £5 is the price of a key.
explanation.kk: «they must not be taller than two metres» → two metres. £5 — кілттің бағасы.
explanation.ru: «they must not be taller than two metres» → two metres. £5 — цена ключа.
